significance: Carlo Ginzburg's Storia notturna: Una decifrazione del sabba (Einaudi, Turin, 1989) — English translation: Ecstasies: Deciphering the Witches' Sabbath (1991) — extended the benandante argument across Eurasian evidence to propose a pan-Eurasian shamanic substrate for the sabbath stereotype, generating the major historiographical debate of the 1990s about the relationship between learned and popular magical traditions.
source_method: Ginzburg, Storia notturna (Einaudi, 1989); English translation: Ecstasies: Deciphering the Witches' Sabbath (Hutchinson Radius, 1991)
